summary: UI-only verification of 3 admin dashboard improvements. All 3 features PASS. (1) orders-search-input filters orders table by customer name (KULDEEP: 64→3 rows), phone (973186922: 64→1 row), and document type (Sale Deed: 64→3 rows). orders-result-count shows 'Showing X of Y orders' correctly. Clearing restores all rows. Non-matching query ('ZZZNOMATCHZZZ') shows 'No orders match your search.' (2) bookmarklet-link-<id> yellow button now displays the order's Purchased By value ('KULDEEP PATGIR') instead of 'SHCIL Autofill' / 'Autofill'. Keeps bg-amber-400 styling and href starts with 'javascript:'. Fallback to customer_name when purchased_by empty is implemented in BookmarkletLink. (3) OrderDetailDialog help text instructs to drag ONCE and reads 'it always fetches this order's latest data automatically. No need to drag it again.' — none of the specified disallowed phrases (drag the button again / drag again / re-generate / regenerate) are present. (4) Decoded bookmarklet href still live-fetches /api/orders/<id>/autofill (verified via urllib.parse.unquote); 'KULDEEP PATGIR' is NOT hardcoded in the decoded JS, so saved bookmarks always get fresh data. (5) Regressions pass: payment-toggle-<id> flips Paid/Unpaid via PATCH /admin/orders/<id>/payment; copy-bookmarklet-<id> fires clipboard copy; tab-reviews loads admin-reviews-list.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js filteredOrders is recomputed on every render inline; fine for current table size (~64) but should move to useMemo if orders list grows large to avoid re-filtering on unrelated state changes (e.g. per-row payment toggle).

BookmarkletLink label truncates at 220px via max-w-[220px] — good; however the dialog help text still reads 'No need to drag it again' which, while semantically correct (telling the user they don't need to re-drag), contains the substring 'drag it again'. If any downstream automated test does a naive substring check it could false-positive. Consider rewording to 'The saved bookmark always loads the newest data — no re-drag required.' for extra clarity.

Decoded bookmarklet IIFE is >5KB and fully re-inlined per order. Since the FIELDS array is identical across orders, the only per-order variance is the URL. Minor: could hoist the IIFE body to a static constant and only template the URL, reducing bundle re-encoding. Non-blocking.
